author: Angus Johnson
documented_use: The studio credits Clipper for polygon Boolean operations. Its article names the library without specifying the release, language binding or individual call sites.
revision_selection: This original release predates the studio article. The archive changelog identifies SVN revision 512.
contents: Original release ZIP with C++, C# and Delphi library sources, examples, documentation and third-party material.
primary_library_license: Boost Software License 1.0. See License.txt in the archive; bundled third-party components retain their notices.
verification: Archive SHA-256 matched the SourceForge file listing. Checked every ZIP member CRC, then compiled the archived C# library and intersected two 10 by 10 squares offset by 5 in each axis. The result contained one polygon with area 25.
